summary: Rush Enterprises filed an 8-K covering Item 5.02 (approval of new base salaries for named executive officers effective July 1, 2026, with Chairman/CEO Rusty Rush at $1,855,802, CFO Keller at $562,506, COO Pollard at $530,450, and SVP Lowe at $527,193) and Items 7.01/8.01 (announcement of dual listing on Nasdaq Texas, effective July 1, 2026, under tickers RUSHA and RUSHB while maintaining primary Nasdaq Global Select Market listing under the same symbols). The filing does not involve any merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special-situation event. It is a routine current report on executive compensation and a listing change.
